recipes.name: Purposeful alternative text
recipes.symptom: An image's role is unclear or missing for nonvisual users
recipes.implementation: Classify decorative, informative, functional and complex imagery; write purpose-equivalent accessible alternatives; use empty alt only for decoration
recipes.acceptance_test: Screen reader identifies each informative image and icon control accurately, and ignores pure decoration
recipes.common_failure: Presence of alt attribute is not proof of equivalent meaning

recipes.name: Data graphic equivalent
recipes.symptom: A chart conveys comparisons only through visual marks
recipes.implementation: Pair concise chart alt with data table or rich narrative of trend, values and exceptional points; keep semantic headers
recipes.acceptance_test: User can answer task-relevant chart questions using only text/table
recipes.common_failure: Saying chart shows sales is not a data equivalent

recipes.name: Edited synchronized captions
recipes.symptom: Prerecorded video loses speech and meaningful sound for deaf viewers
recipes.implementation: Provide selectable caption track with correct timing, speaker identities and non-speech cues; manually review captions
recipes.acceptance_test: Reviewer watches complete clip with sound muted and can understand spoken and sound information
recipes.common_failure: Raw speech-to-text without speaker/sound review is inadequate

recipes.name: Audio description for meaningful visual action
recipes.symptom: Meaningful onscreen action is not conveyed by dialogue
recipes.implementation: Produce described version or audio-description track for AA; for A a complete media alternative may also work
recipes.acceptance_test: Blind reviewer understands actions, titles and meaningful graphics without video
recipes.common_failure: Transcript alone does not satisfy AA 1.2.5

recipes.name: Live media accessibility
recipes.symptom: Live synchronized captions or live audio-only equivalent are absent
recipes.implementation: Integrate trained real-time captions for synchronized live media; provide timely live audio-only alternative at AAA
recipes.acceptance_test: Observe live event and assess latency, completeness and speaker distinguishability
recipes.common_failure: Later transcript is insufficient for live requirement

recipes.name: Semantic page regions and headings
recipes.symptom: Page visual grouping is not reflected in structure
recipes.implementation: Use main/nav/header landmarks, actual headings, list and label elements rather than styled div elements
recipes.acceptance_test: Headings/landmarks navigation exposes meaningful page hierarchy
recipes.common_failure: aria-label on arbitrary div does not automatically create a heading

recipes.name: Table relationship repair
recipes.symptom: Headers and cells are not associated
recipes.implementation: Use caption, th scope=row/col or explicit headers IDs for complex tables; retain original relationships when responsive
recipes.acceptance_test: Screen reader reports correct row/column headers for representative cells
recipes.common_failure: Responsive card conversion can sever header associations

recipes.name: Logical reading order
recipes.symptom: CSS layout shows content out of semantic and focus sequence
recipes.implementation: Align meaningful DOM order with visual sequence; avoid CSS-only reorder and positive tabindex
recipes.acceptance_test: Keyboard and linear reader encounter prerequisite information before related controls
recipes.common_failure: Visual order and focus order can disagree without screen reader evidence

recipes.name: Redundant non-color cues
recipes.symptom: Important state or instruction uses color/position only
recipes.implementation: Add labelled statuses, patterns, icons with accessible names or explicit instructions
recipes.acceptance_test: Grayscale/high contrast and nonvisual review preserve same meaning
recipes.common_failure: Contrast 4.5 alone does not fix color-only meaning

recipes.name: Minimum and enhanced text contrast
recipes.symptom: Text blends into backdrop
recipes.implementation: Assign accessible semantic color tokens for normal/large text and modes; test opacity and gradients
recipes.acceptance_test: Rendered text meets 4.5:1/3:1 at AA or 7:1/4.5:1 at AAA subject to exceptions
recipes.common_failure: Do not apply UI control 3:1 rule to ordinary text

recipes.name: Narrow viewport reflow
recipes.symptom: Page requires horizontal and vertical scrolling to follow text
recipes.implementation: Convert layout to responsive single column; wrap text and constrain only intrinsically 2D regions
recipes.acceptance_test: At 320 CSS px width no two-dimensional scrolling needed for ordinary content; functions remain intact
recipes.common_failure: Data table exception is local, not a license for page overflow

recipes.name: Text scaling and spacing override
recipes.symptom: Fixed height or no-wrap makes text clip under accessibility settings
recipes.implementation: Use content-based sizing, relative units, wrapping and flexible layout; remove clipped overflow
recipes.acceptance_test: 200% text enlarge and all four specified spacing overrides cause no loss
recipes.common_failure: Override tolerance is not a requirement to use those spacings by default

recipes.name: Hover/focus revealed content
recipes.symptom: Tooltip disappears when trying to read or dismiss
recipes.implementation: Make triggered content dismissible where required, hoverable and persistent; manage Escape behavior
recipes.acceptance_test: Hover popup remains while pointer moves inside; dismiss and focus behavior function
recipes.common_failure: Automatically dismissing on tiny pointer movement violates persistent reading

recipes.name: Native keyboard-operable controls
recipes.symptom: Clickable div or custom control is mouse-only
recipes.implementation: Use button, link, input or other native control; only custom-build with full keyboard behavior
recipes.acceptance_test: Enter/Space and expected keys operate; AT exposes correct role and state
recipes.common_failure: tabindex alone does not provide native button activation

recipes.name: Dialog focus lifecycle
recipes.symptom: Modal loses focus, traps keyboard indefinitely or returns to wrong place
recipes.implementation: On open, assign labelled dialog and logical initial focus; keep modal focus bounded; restore on close; visible focus
recipes.acceptance_test: Keyboard can enter, navigate, dismiss and return to logical invoker without trap
recipes.common_failure: Moving focus to removed invoker after delete can strand user

recipes.name: Character shortcut safety
recipes.symptom: Single-letter global key conflicts with user typing or voice dictation
recipes.implementation: Disable, remap with modifier, or scope shortcut to focused component
recipes.acceptance_test: Typing character while outside intended component never accidentally activates command
recipes.common_failure: Modifier shortcuts are not within this specific requirement

recipes.name: Skip navigation and dynamic title
recipes.symptom: Repeated header is inescapable or route title unclear
recipes.implementation: Provide focus-visible skip link, meaningful main target, and update document.title on SPA route changes
recipes.acceptance_test: Keyboard skip reaches main; browser tab shows accurate route title
recipes.common_failure: Page h1 does not automatically set document.title

recipes.name: Clear links and destination context
recipes.symptom: Repeated generic links obscure destination
recipes.implementation: Use descriptive link text or programmatic context for A; make link-only self-sufficient for AAA
recipes.acceptance_test: Inspect links list and associated context; purpose of each link understandable at chosen level
recipes.common_failure: Visual adjacent text may not be programmatically associated

recipes.name: Find pages in more than one way
recipes.symptom: Users cannot rediscover a page or know location
recipes.implementation: Provide navigation plus search/index/sitemap; location breadcrumbs for AAA where applicable
recipes.acceptance_test: Find representative non-process page by two mechanisms; orient in hierarchy
recipes.common_failure: Pages that are steps in a process have a specific 2.4.5 exception

recipes.name: User-controllable time limits
recipes.symptom: Task expires abruptly or loses entries
recipes.implementation: Implement allowed timer off/adjust/extension path; disclose potential idle data loss at AAA
recipes.acceptance_test: Test warning >=20s and >=10 extensions if chosen, or valid alternate/exemption
recipes.common_failure: Real-time exception needs justification, not a general authentication excuse

recipes.name: Reauthentication continuation
recipes.symptom: Session expiry deletes user progress
recipes.implementation: Persist appropriate draft/transaction state and restore after reauthentication; protect secrets
recipes.acceptance_test: Renew expired auth and continue same task with data intact without renewing stale credentials
recipes.common_failure: Insecurely storing credentials is not an acceptable accessibility fix

recipes.name: Moving content and seizure safety
recipes.symptom: Unpausable ticker or flash-heavy media causes barriers
recipes.implementation: Add pause/stop/hide for qualifying content; remove or verify flash frequencies and thresholds
recipes.acceptance_test: User can stop applicable movement; flashing measurements satisfy targeted level
recipes.common_failure: Reduced-motion option cannot repair dangerous default flashes

recipes.name: Interaction animation control
recipes.symptom: Parallax/zoom animation triggers vestibular symptoms
recipes.implementation: Provide motion disable switch or honor reduced-motion media query in JS and CSS
recipes.acceptance_test: With reduced motion enabled, nonessential interaction motion is absent
recipes.common_failure: Only AAA 2.3.3; distinguish from A flash safety requirements

recipes.name: Path-independent pointer alternative
recipes.symptom: Only pinch/swipe/drag works
recipes.implementation: Add ordinary visible controls such as zoom buttons, reorder buttons and prev/next
recipes.acceptance_test: Complete task with single pointer without path gesture, and with keyboard where needed
recipes.common_failure: A fake alternate control that produces different result is not equivalent

recipes.name: Cancellation and speech-compatible naming
recipes.symptom: Press-down executes destructive action; voice command cannot match visible label
recipes.implementation: Use click/up activation with cancel/undo and ensure visible text appears in accessible name
recipes.acceptance_test: Drag off before release prevents actuation or undo works; voice user can say visible label
recipes.common_failure: Accessible name may contain extra context, but not omit visible words

recipes.name: AAA pointer target area
recipes.symptom: Small adjacent controls hard to hit
recipes.implementation: Provide >=44x44 CSS px targets or record applicable exception
recipes.acceptance_test: Measure rendered clickable target in CSS pixels on touch layout
recipes.common_failure: 24px WCAG 2.2 AA formula is not WCAG 2.1 AAA requirement

recipes.name: Language declaration
recipes.symptom: Speech synthesis mispronounces main or embedded languages
recipes.implementation: Set page lang and lang on actual changes in passage language
recipes.acceptance_test: AT uses appropriate pronunciation, and metadata reflects content
recipes.common_failure: Locale does not reliably identify every quoted phrase's language

recipes.name: Explicit context-changing actions
recipes.symptom: Focus or selection unexpectedly navigates
recipes.implementation: Keep focus and simple input passive; use explicit Apply/Continue or advance warning where permitted
recipes.acceptance_test: Tab and change values without unintended page/window/focus transition
recipes.common_failure: Updating a content panel is not necessarily a context change

recipes.name: Persistent form instructions and autocomplete
recipes.symptom: Form lacks label/instructions or eligible personal field lacks purpose token
recipes.implementation: Use label/for, fieldset/legend, visible instructions and correct autocomplete taxonomy
recipes.acceptance_test: User and AT know requested input; eligible fields expose machine-readable purpose
recipes.common_failure: Placeholder is not stable instruction; autocomplete is not applicable to all fields

recipes.name: Repairable errors and safe submission
recipes.symptom: Invalid data not explained; high-risk submit lacks correction/reversal
recipes.implementation: Add text error, actionable correction, data retention and confirmation/reversal/check as applicable
recipes.acceptance_test: User can find, fix and resubmit; risky transactions have one compliant safeguard
recipes.common_failure: AA safeguards apply only to enumerated high-impact submissions; AAA expands scope

recipes.name: Polite and assertive status channels
recipes.symptom: Async updates do not reach screen reader or custom state is wrong
recipes.implementation: Use appropriate native state and persistent aria-live/role=status region, with alert for urgent messages
recipes.acceptance_test: AT announces status without forcing focus and reads accurate component name/role/state
recipes.common_failure: Multiple assertive alerts produce unusable noisy feedback

notes: Each recipe is an implementation starting point. Read normative criterion and relevant W3C Understanding page before deciding exceptions and claiming a pass.
